#: Ragdoll: reading skeleton.hkx for where the game stands the bodies of a skeleton.
ragdoll.badPair: %(file)s maps bone %(a)d to bone %(b)d, past the end of a skeleton
ragdoll.bigEndian: %(file)s is written for a big-endian console; only files of the PC editions are read
ragdoll.noMapper: %(file)s has a ragdoll but no mapping between it and the animation skeleton
ragdoll.noReader: the PyNifly in use has no reader of Havok files (pyn/havok_packfile.py); a newer add-on has one
ragdoll.pointer: %(file)s has %(size)d-byte pointers; only 4 and 8 are known
ragdoll.version: %(file)s is written by Havok %(version)s; the fields of a skeleton are known here for %(want)s
